caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, stylized rooster figure oriented toward the right, rendered in shades of brown and gray. The rooster is carved with pronounced, curved lines representing feathers on its tail and body, and has a textured surface to indicate its plumage. The figure is mounted on a vertical brown stick, which extends downward from the center of the underside of the body. The entire rooster, including the head, body, tail, and stick, is centrally positioned against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or details. The tail feathers occupy the left side of the composition and are broad and fan-like, while the head is at the upper right, showing a simple beak, comb, and eye. The composition is balanced with the rooster as the sole subject.
title: Rooster Weather Vane
